**Finding: deviation (critical) — Article XIII, ¶ p0130**

The liability regime is one-sided in Licensor's favour on every parameter the playbook tests:

- **Cap is one-way and illusory**: only "LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY" is capped, at "ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE" — below the six-months'-fees walk-away floor. Our liability is uncapped, and is amplified by the broad Article XII indemnity (¶ p0128–p0129) covering our exercise of the licence, conduct of our business and any breach.
- **Exclusion of indirect/consequential damages runs only in Licensor's favour**, and ¶ p0130(a) goes further by disclaiming all Licensor liability for third-party IP infringement claims.
- **No carve-outs at all** for confidentiality/data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement.

Redline validated (ok:true): made both the exclusion and the cap mutual, reset the basis to the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, inserted an "Excluded Claims" super-cap definition, and confirmed our fee obligations are not capped damages. Fallback offered in the comment is a mutual 12-month fee cap with carve-outs limited to indemnity, confidentiality and gross negligence/wilful misconduct.
